title: The Pink Snow Day Kit for Little Girls
description: A pink snow day kit for little girls from Sam's Club: a floral Hurley snowboard jacket, pink snow pants, pink snow boots, a beanie and mittens set, HotHands hand warmers and Swiss Miss cocoa.
intro: The first snow day always catches me with one mitten and zero matching boots. This year the whole kit lives by the front door: the floral jacket, pink snow pants, the boots, hat and mittens, a box of hand warmers and a ridiculous amount of hot cocoa. Out the door in five minutes, back in for cocoa in twenty. That is the dream and I am sticking to it.

sections.heading: The outfit
paragraphs: A Hurley big girls snowboard jacket in a pink and lilac watercolor floral, Hurley pink snow pants with black straps, and Member's Mark pink youth snow boots with toggle laces.

sections.heading: Hat, mittens and the warm-up
paragraphs: The Hurley pink beanie and mittens set, a 36-pair box of HotHands hand warmers for pockets, and a 50-count box of Swiss Miss milk chocolate cocoa with marshmallows for after.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The hallway, props and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
